analysis_limitations: All pre-breach acquisitions up to the strict cutoff inform fitted states, so early pre-breach trajectories are development-exposed retrospective reconstructions rather than prospective precursor validation.
Each query uses only its same-site causal acquisition prefix; future acquisitions never enter that query context.
The parity-1 monitor shares acquisition scenes with parity-0 fitting and does not establish independent temporal or physical support.
Historical operational availability, lake geometry validity, physical sampling independence, and independent calibration exposure are unresolved.

isolation_forest.missing_route: weighted expectation by fitted left/right child n_node_samples; all-missing row abstains
isolation_forest.score_direction: higher means shorter expected path / more anomalous

psd_rbf_one_class_svm.algorithm: OneClassSVM with fixed zero-sentinel plus observed-bit map and PSD Gaussian RBF
